title: The Slow Orbit Again
author: Casper Lockridge
blurb: Cyrus Blackwood, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
